definitions: A comprehensive solution provided by Splunk that enables monitoring, troubleshooting, and analysis of the performance and health of Splunk agents and the systems they run on.
The capability within the Splunk ecosystem to gain deep insights into the operational state, resource utilization, and data collection activities of Splunk Universal Forwarders and other agent types.
examples: Splunk Agent Observability is crucial for maintaining a healthy data ingestion pipeline.
Our team uses Splunk Agent Observability to identify bottlenecks in data forwarding.
Enhanced Splunk Agent Observability led to a significant reduction in troubleshooting time.
